# Cressida Lindsay

## Overview

- **Age:** 18 years old during her Freshman year at Wexcombe College  <sub>[v3 c4 P53](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0053), [v3 c26 P4](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c4 P1](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v4 c27 P19](../source/v04-c27.md#nw-v04-c27-p0019)</sub>
- **Origin:** Harborough, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c4 P31](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0031), [v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032)</sub>
- **Role:** Student at Wexcombe College, later a minister's wife and homemaker  <sub>[v3 c4 P1](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0001), [v4 c24 P10](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0010)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mrs. Ezra Hale  <sub>[v3 c21 P1](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0001), [v4 c24 P10](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0010)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Cressy  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Cressida is a tall and slender young woman with a striking, uneven, and captivating beauty. She has a radiant, rosy-cheeked complexion, plush dark eyes beneath black eyebrows, and an asymmetrical mouth with very white teeth. Her hair is thick, golden-brown, and wavy, and she wears stylish attire, often favoring wild-rose pink or yellow gowns.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020), [v3 c4 P39](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0039), [v3 c33 P7](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0007), [v3 c33 P9](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0009), [v3 c35 P1](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0001), [v4 c21 P0](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0000)_

## Personality

Cressida is gay, lively, impulsive, and affectionately loyal, possessing a playful sense of humor and a dramatic flair. Though she appears shallow, lightheaded, and indecisive on the surface, she is warm-hearted, unselfish, and surprisingly steadfast once her heart is set. She enjoys social life and the company of admirers, yet she possesses genuine intellectual ability and a deeply affectionate, womanly nature beneath her flirtatious exterior.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028), [v3 c4 P44](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0044), [v3 c26 P21](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0021), [v3 c34 P15](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0015), [v4 c27 P20](../source/v04-c27.md#nw-v04-c27-p0020)_

- Indecisive  <sub>[v3 c4 P26](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0026), [v3 c4 P52](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0052)</sub>

- To enjoy her youth and college life while pursuing a degree  <sub>[v3 c4 P50](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0050)</sub>
- To support her husband in his ministry in the Tanner Street mission  <sub>[v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v3 c27 P31](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0031)</sub>

## History

Cressida arrived at Wexcombe College from Harborough as a Freshman, quickly becoming close friends with Nell Harcourt and Honora Hollis. During her first year, she joined Nell, Honora, and Mabel Colby in renting Tabby's Place, a small house on Linden Avenue managed by Aunt Euphemia. Over the course of her studies, she was courted by numerous suitors, including two prominent home-town admirers, Hector and Orlando, but eventually fell in love with Ezra Hale, an earnest theology student. Despite her mother's initial objections to marrying a poor minister, Cressida stood firm and engaged herself to Ezra. She successfully completed her degree at Wexcombe, graduating with Honors in Mathematics. Following graduation, she married Ezra Hale in a wedding at her family's estate, Mount Holly, and subsequently moved with him to support his ministry at a mission church on Tanner Street.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P1](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0001), [v3 c4 P31](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0031), [v3 c4 P53](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0053), [v3 c10 P52](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0052), [v3 c24 P8](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0008), [v3 c24 P21](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0021), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v3 c37 P3](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0003), [v4 c27 P19](../source/v04-c27.md#nw-v04-c27-p0019), [v4 c29 P8](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0008)_
